commitResults.messageTitle: Added test-ui skill and ToDos/Events/Deadlines features
Revised test-plan to be more robust in testing
Extract file persistence into a Storage class
commitResults.messageBody:
First step of the A-MoreOOP refactor toward separate Ui / Storage /
Parser / TaskList classes. This increment moves all task-file handling
out of Altair:

- New Storage class owns the data-file path and the load()/save()
  operations, plus the private line-parsing helper (taskFromFileLine)
  and a small parseStoredDate() helper. Storage is constructed with the
  file path (new Storage("./data/duke.txt")), matching the target
  design, so the location is no longer hard-coded deep in Altair.
- Altair now holds a single STORAGE field and calls STORAGE.load() /
  STORAGE.save(tasks) instead of the removed static loadTasks() /
  saveTasks() / taskFromFileLine() methods.
- Removed the now-unused java.io / java.nio.file / ArrayList imports and
  the TASKS_FILE constant from Altair.

Behavior is unchanged: the same messages are produced on load and save
failures (load errors are still reported per line as "I couldn't load
your tasks on line N."). All 14 UI test-plan cases pass.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract console interaction into a Ui class
commitResults.messageBody:
Second step of the A-MoreOOP refactor. All reading from and printing to
the console now lives in one class:

- New Ui class owns the Scanner, the SEPARATOR and BANNER constants, and
  a named method for every response: hasNextCommand()/readCommand(),
  showLine(), showWelcome(), showError(), showGoodbye(), showTaskList(),
  showAdded(), showMarked(), showUnmarked(), showDeleted(). Each method
  prints exactly the same text as before.
- Altair holds a single UI field and no longer references System.in,
  System.out, Scanner, or the separator/banner strings.
- The main loop now follows the target shape: the per-response divider
  is printed once in a finally block instead of being repeated at the
  end of every branch, and the mark/unmark/delete helpers lost their
  trailing-separator responsibility (and their separator parameter).
  Removed the printAddedTask helper, folded into Ui.showAdded().

Behavior is unchanged; all 14 UI test-plan cases pass. The BYE branch
still prints its farewell followed by a divider because the finally
block runs on the way out of the loop.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix Gradle mainClass to match altair package
commitResults.messageBody:
The add-gradle-support branch was based on a pre-restructuring commit,
so mainClass still pointed at the removed seedu.duke.Duke class,
breaking ./gradlew run and the shadow jar.

Add StorageTest covering the highest-value untested logic: Storage.save
and Storage.load (file persistence and the line/date parsing they drive),
using a JUnit @TempDir so tests never touch the real ./data/ folder.

Document a 50% test coverage target in AGENTS.md, aimed at the most
complex, core, or business-critical methods, and extend the code update
workflow to require updating the JUnit tests and running ./gradlew test
after every code change.
